detached_structure.evidence: A separate gray-roofed building sits north of the central house, near the rear of the lot, with a smaller outbuilding or shed next to it and a van parked beside it.
detached_structure.detail: Likely a rear garage or outbuilding; it could belong to the neighboring lot to the north.

signals.notes: The central house has a gray roof with a rear deck or flat-roofed addition on the west side. Two dark vehicles are parked in the driveway or on the apron along the street edge. Large trees border the lot on several sides, and there is a hedge to the north.
